# Finesh Maker Way

> > A personal hiking journal documenting the Camino de Santiago pilgrimage along the Le Puy route from Le-Puy-en-Velay to Santiago de Compostela through France.

This site chronicles a long-distance hiking journey on the Camino Le Puy (also known as the Le Puy Way or Via Podiensis), one of the historic pilgrimage routes to Santiago de Compostela. The journey traverses through the French countryside, passing through notable towns and villages including Montbonnet, Monistrol-d'Allier, Aumont-Aubrac, Conques, and Estaing.
